summary:
Lane A of v2.74 is built and checked, in /home/user/Cartalith_GDT/html/Cartalith v2.74 DCC test.html (final md5 725e0bba0b6124154e057042bf20b1b1). It covers every item of PLAN.md §5 plus the F06 toll fix. Each finding was re-opened at its symbol in v2.74 first, and each change has a "v2.74 (Vxx/Pxx)" comment at the rule or function it changes.

Correctness:
- P7: the Sun slider's cache key now reads state.sunAz. Checking every key part against the state literal found a second misnamed part: state.shadeOnHypso is a checkbox id, the state field is state.shadeHypso. A sweep of all 47 controls that call render() found a third: state.showRivers was missing from the key. On v2.73 four control/view pairs served a stale image; on v2.74, 0 of 94 control changes do.
- V01: Settlements rows are display:flex again, and the table head now lines up with the rows within 1px (it was off by up to 10px).
- V10: Credits opens above Settings (z-index 76), on the desktop and on a phone.
- V04: both armed pins (Assets, Settlements) are a wash plus an edge instead of the accent fill.
- V05/V06: the three windows' × buttons are readable in light; the Settlements screen is on --panel and the route editor on --bg.
- V23: phone faction names are no longer 0px wide. "Largest by population" is dashed with a reason, and both reasons are tested.
- V11: the busy overlay sits at z-index 30, over the map's own controls and under menus and the place popup.
- #assetsPanel: in Assets mode the left dock now stays on desktop and tablet, showing only the pack panel. Its head reads "Assets › Pack". It floats over the library below AL_STAGE_MIN (824px). Validate works on a real click, and Find has an owner for the panel.
- V16: the place popup is capped at the map's height on desktop and tablet.

Contrast and native controls:
- V02: color-scheme per theme, and accent-color on checkboxes and radios.
- V08: --faint is #7d8285 dark and #676762 light.
- V09: light --accent is #8b550d; the light washes keep the old hue on purpose.
- V12 first half: the place popup is re-tokened in light only.
- V03: active sub-tabs and Settings pages draw one 2px side.
- V19 focus ring, V20 text fields, V21 boxes behind the scale bar and legend.
- The census also found two faults the audit had not named, both fixed: white names on light faction colours in the faction picker (ink now chosen by contrast, _civInkOn), and the route editor's "(land)" note.

Clipping and copy: V07, V13, V14, V15 (picker padding 7px), V17, V18 (tabs size to their labels, flex 1 1 auto), V22, V25 arrow, V28.

Shell speed:
- P4: the browser branch fills #view flat instead of rendering; "Skip for now" renders once. The headless branch is untouched.
- V272-1/-2: _shellPlace no longer forces a layout. The window resize listeners schedule the refit, which publishes the band heights first. _syncChromeTop reads both bands before writing, and writes only a changed value.

F06: _jpClaimedAt now tests > 0. The planner hints are reworded, the comments updated, and the effect is measured and disclosed.

Docs written: html/CHANGELOG_v2.74.md, html/CLAUDE_v2.74.md, and README rows, verification commands and device checks. New files: html/tests/perf/probe_v274fix.js, census_v274.js, shots_v274.js, and 13 screenshots in html/evidence/v2.74/ (7 looked at). PROGRESS.md lists every CSS rule lane A touched, for lane B.
open_issues: Phone: #assetsPanel (pack metadata, Validate) is still unreachable in Assets mode on a phone. The sheet's domain page leaves the library first (v2.73's rule). MENU › Assets reaches Export, Open pack, Apply and Clear. Disclosed in the CHANGELOG.

Found, not fixed: _lodRenderKey (the LOD tiles' cache key) lacks state.bioBlend, which renderBiomeTileRGBA reads. This is the same class of bug as P7, in the LOD cache, and belongs to v2.75's speed pass.

Needs a person on a device: one native select list and one number spinner per theme (V02); Segoe UI on Windows for V14, V15 (one feature hidden at 1366 with Inter) and V18 (359px of 371 with Inter); Credits on a real phone (V10). The owner should look at the flat start-card backdrop (Q10a) and at the overlay taking map input mid-generate (Q10b).

Lane B (corner radii, V24 washed segments, the V25 label rule, V26, V29, V30) follows in the same file. Segmented controls, the Settlements window tabs and the CIVIL tools segment still draw the solid accent fill. PROGRESS.md lists every rule lane A changed.
RC's smoke_gen1.js was not run (it is not in the plan's gates). It was only grepped: its planner checks use fixed stage objects or a monkey-patched _jpDeriveStages.
Two run.sh assertions depend on the random world (bathymetry variance, traced length). They flake in unpinned runs and pass on pinned seeds for both versions. Disclosed, not fixed.
judgement_calls: P7: went beyond the misnamed state.sun. Fixed state.shadeOnHypso → shadeHypso and added state.showRivers, both found by checking every key part and sweeping every render-calling control (MISTAKES' cache-key row).

V01: added CSS so the table head and rows share one column grid (cells get min-width 0; the head gets the list's 1px side borders). The display:flex fix alone left the columns 1–10px apart, against the 1px bar.
V04: the Settlements pin also takes the wash. Its v2.73 accent fill was readable (--accInk), but it broke theme rule 3; the CSS comment says so rather than claiming a contrast fault.
V09: the light washes keep the old accent hue (164,101,15). On #8b550d, accent on wash2 would be 4.41 and fail AA.
V16: used the plan's exact fix (JS maxHeight from _viewportRect on desktop and tablet) rather than the calc(100vh-232px) approximation. The phone is unchanged.
V15: also cut the picker chips' padding from 9px to 7px a side. With only the order fix, v2.73-era layout still hid 2 features at 1366; the bar is at most 1.
V18: added flex:1 1 auto. With equal basis, SETTLEMENTS' 86px of text was cut inside a 74px tab even though the dock no longer scrolled. Letter-spacing .02em and padding 2px kept from the audit.
V22: new empty Context hint 'Shows what you select'. It fits whole and does not repeat the body; the markup copy is updated too.
V19: the ring also applies to text fields, a labelled judgement. The design states a ring for its chips only (.dk-chip:focus-visible).

#assetsPanel: fixed at the v2.24 rule. The left dock stays in Assets mode (desktop and tablet) and the docking rule is asked of the library (AL_STAGE_MIN = rail 190 + inspector 300 + two 150px tile columns with gap and padding). Also added: a Find owner, the dock-head label, and a tool-options hint that names the panel. Phone left unchanged.
P4: the flat backdrop is the measured mean colour of v2.73's boot render (rgb 73,102,118), a labelled judgement. #view is still sized to GW×GH so the layout and cover zoom match.

V272: changing _shellPlace alone moved the forced layout to _shellDockSync, with no net gain. The count fell only after deferring the two window resize listeners that measured before placement into the scheduled refit, running _syncChromeTop first there, and making it read-then-write-if-changed. The v0.87 synchronous fill on resize is now done in the refit's frame.
Census follow-ups the audit had not named: the faction-picker ink is chosen per faction colour (_civInkOn), and the route editor's '(land)' note is --dim instead of opacity .55.

V23's dash has two verified branches: 'no settlements yet', and 'no faction holds a populated settlement' when the only settlements are Unclaimed. The plan's text named only the first; the second keeps the reason true.
report_text_for_main_loop:
For the main loop to route; lane A did not touch the guarded docs.

STATUS.md: v2.74's first lane is built — the fix pass from html/audits/v2.72-2026-11-01/PLAN.md §5 and Ruling EC item 6 (the toll fix). It is in html/Cartalith v2.74 DCC test.html at md5 725e0bba. Verification:
- run.sh 1280/0, with two random-world asserts that flake (disclosed); run_um 882/0; hash_gen1 vs v2.73 ALL IDENTICAL.
- probe_v274fix.js 131/0, failing 92 on v2.73.
- census_v274.js: 0 of 2,408 enabled text runs below AA, against v2.73's 561.
- probe_mobileshell 279/0; probe_desktopshell 154/4, v2.73's four by design.
- The load's longest task 2.7 s → 0.33 s.
The second lane (corners and design alignment, Ruling EF) follows in the same file.

OUTSTANDING_WORK.md, "Found in the HTML by stage 1":
- #assetsPanel is fixed on desktop and tablet in v2.74; the phone still has no route to the pack metadata and Validate.
- The place editor over the expanded strip at 1366×768 is fixed in v2.74 (V16).
- New row for v2.75's speed pass: _lodRenderKey has no state.bioBlend, so the Relief↔biome slider would serve stale LOD tiles.

MISTAKES.md candidates (merge into existing rows):
- "Add a capability, or write a staleness/cache key": the same _civBakeKey had a second misnamed part (state.shadeOnHypso — the checkbox's id, not the state field) and a missing input (state.showRivers). Verify with a sweep built from the source (every bind(...render()) and change listener): change each control once and compare the cached frame with a cache-cleared render, in each view mode.
- New, "Remove a forced layout": deleting one read-after-write moves the forced layout to the next reader (here _shellDockSync), so the count does not fall. Find every reader with a timeline trace (Layout events carry a stackTrace), including window 'resize' listeners registered before the code that moves the DOM.
- "Add a probe in the same commit that changes the behaviour", one more instance: v2.74's chip check used .map-tl .funnel-btn, which also matches #layersBtn, so it compared the chip with itself and passed on v2.73. Only running the probe on v2.73 caught it.
- "Report a layout measurement": the audit's "the head still lines up (screenshot)" was 1–10px off once measured.
